title: MERIDIAN: reference implementation, PayeeBench benchmark, formal models and experiment harness for payee verification in agentic payments
description:
MERIDIAN is a payer-side check that the party about to receive an agent's payment is authorized to receive for the brand the user meant, and that the money went there. This archive contains the reference implementation, the PayeeBench benchmark, Tamarin and ProVerif models, the pre-registration of hypotheses H1-H5, and the experiment harness. Running make reproduce regenerates every table and figure from fixed seeds.

Release v1.x accompanies the paper on verifiable discharge (authority-to-receive verification); release v2.x accompanies the paper on window-safe settlement checks and private payee proofs. See the paper map in README.md.

The passive web measurement (E10) depends on live DNS, TLS and GLEIF data and gives different numbers on a later run; the archived results record the collection date. Live-backend results were obtained on Stripe test mode only. The Groth16 setup uses fixed test entropy and must not protect real payments.
